<div class="about-text">

<h2>Marketing with a media mindset.</h2>

<p>
Growing up in San Francisco, sports and entertainment have always been a big part of what I follow. I'm especially interested in the San Francisco Giants and the Cincinnati Bengals (my love for the Bengals comes from my dad growing up in Cincinnati).
</p>

<p>
That interest in sports and entertainment has shaped the kinds of marketing and media work I'm drawn to. I'm particularly interested in how teams, entertainment brands, creators, and media companies build audiences and turn stories into experiences worth following.
</p>

<p>
At Cal Poly Pomona, I'm pursuing a B.S. in Business Administration with an emphasis in Marketing and a minor in Communications (Multimedia Journalism). My coursework has allowed me to explore marketing strategy, consumer behavior, research, entertainment marketing, sports communication, journalism and digital media.
</p>

<p>
Outside of the classroom, I've gained hands-on experience in digital marketing, social media, content strategy, video editing, and audience growth. I've worked in marketing and social media roles, including leading digital growth strategies, influencer campaigns, and social platforms, while also developing freelance video content using Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects.
</p>

<p>
I'm especially passionate about long-form content creation and pop culture. I enjoy taking a topic I'm interested in and turning it into something people can spend time with, from a marketing analysis or multimedia stories, to visual content.
</p>

<p>
My goal is to work where strategy and creativity can overlap: understanding an audience, developing an idea and figuring out how to tell the story in a way that makes people care.
</p>

</div>

</div>
